1.summary: The shared files, the lab action, Dependabot, CODEOWNERS and the pull request template, the four rulesets as data, and ci.yml with static (which fetches the catalogs this one needs), seed, compile and result.
manual: Give the repository its Lab key while the Lab is private: make settings prints the commands.
A catalog that requires another, while that one is private: name it under needs in .github/standard.json and give the repository its read key, NEEDS_DEPLOY_KEY.
settings: Apply the rulesets and the repository settings: make settings APPLY=1 shows the requests, and make settings APPLY=1 YES=1 makes them.

2.summary: Adds nightly.yml, which runs every night (the newest Lab, standard drift, the links of the guides, the rules of the main branch, one issue), and starts what needs no platform in the Apps job.
settings: Keep the workflow Nightly enabled: make settings shows its state.

3.summary: Adds publish.yml (rendered once catalog.yml sets images, nothing is published before), the e2e.yml module (--with e2e), and the scan of the published images in nightly.yml.
manual: To publish images, set images in catalog.yml to ghcr.io/OWNER/REPO and name each image ghcr.io/OWNER/REPO/UNIT-APP, then run catalog.py upgrade again.
For the e2e.yml module, store GRAVITEE_LICENSE only as a secret of the environments e2e and e2e-nightly, never as a repository secret.
settings: Create the environments publish, e2e and e2e-nightly the same way: repo-settings shows what is missing.

4.summary: Names every job and every step in plain words (Checks, Seed files, Apps; Newest Lab, Pinned Lab; Plan, Images, Attestations, Release), and runs nightly.yml every night, as its name says, instead of every week. No file is added.

5.summary: On a push to main, the Checks job says what is merged and not released yet: a warning, and the notes of the next release in its summary. The Lab offers releases, not main. CI checks the catalog with a release of the Lab: the commit .github/standard.json pins is the commit of a tag vX.Y.Z (SD11), and catalog.py upgrade --lab-ref latest pins the latest one. No file is added.
manual: If CI says SD11, pin the latest release of the Lab: catalog.py upgrade --lab-ref latest --write.

6.summary: The Apps job of a pull request scans the images it built, with the scanner the Lab pins and the policy of the nightly scan: a critical flaw that has a fix fails the pull request (SC01), and the rest is said (SC02). It needs no secret, so a fork's pull request is scanned too, and only the images of the units the change touches are built and scanned. The nightly scan of the published images says the rest as well. The Seed files job runs Python 3.15, and a new catalog's sample add-on runs whoami v1.12.0. No file is added.
manual: If a pull request says SC01, update the package or the base image of that app to the version the message names, then push again.

7.summary: Adds versions.yml to the e2e module: every night each playground is tried on the releases of Gravitee it does not say it was tested with yet (the newest release of each of the five newest minor versions, and a pre-release above them). What works is written in its x-gravitee.tested, committed to main and released as the next patch version; what does not work opens an issue. The rulesets of main and of the tags let a deploy key through, for that commit and that tag, and two rulesets that no deploy key passes, history.json and tag-history.json, keep it from deleting or rewriting main or a tag.
manual: Give versions.yml its key, in the repository's folder: ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -N '' -C versions -f versions-key, then gh repo deploy-key add versions-key.pub --allow-write --title versions, then gh secret set VERSIONS_DEPLOY_KEY --env versions < versions-key, then rm versions-key versions-key.pub.
settings: Create the environment versions, limited to main, and apply the rulesets again: make settings APPLY=1 shows the requests.

8.summary: The catalog's own runs on main, the end-to-end one and versions.yml, allow its items to use the machine, each for the reason its x-gravitee.host_access gives, as a person does at Add: what is on main was reviewed. The run of a pull request never does. A playground that needs a privileged cluster is now tried every night like the others. No file is added.

9.summary: The end-to-end run and versions.yml log in to Gravitee's private registry, graviteeio.azurecr.io, before they start an item, when the environment holds a token that reads it: an item that pulls from it is tried like the others. Without the token nothing changes. No file is added.
manual: When an item pulls from graviteeio.azurecr.io: a token of that registry that only reads (az acr token create --scope-map _repositories_pull), in the environments e2e and e2e-nightly, as GRAVITEE_REGISTRY_USERNAME and GRAVITEE_REGISTRY_PASSWORD.

10.summary: versions.yml looks for a new release of Gravitee every 30 minutes, not every night: a release is tried on the playgrounds within half an hour of its publication. When none is new, its plan reads Docker Hub and starts nothing. Every set it tries goes in the matrix of the catalog, docs/compatibility.md, which it writes. A set that fails opens an issue for its playground and minor version, closed once a set of that minor version works, and is not tried again until the playground or the Lab changes. A release of the catalog follows only a change of a tested.
